# aws-observability

Alarms that cannot notify (actions disabled or no targets) and orchestrators invisible to tracing - observability gaps measured from cloudwatch/xray/stepfunctions dumps.

## Error codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AF-COLLECT-AWS` | the AWS call failed; the named operation is in the detail |
